verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents automated workflows, including ingestion workflows that can be built with natural-language prompts in an AI Editor, plus continuous monitoring and evidence collection, which implies platform-run recurring checks. However, nothing in the evidence shows a user can define a schedule, recurrence interval or cron-style trigger for their own jobs. Missing for 10: explicit user-configurable scheduling/recurrence for workflows, documentation of schedule triggers on ingestion workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
